component.name: RGCopy
component.summary: Copy and move files with rsync, like TeraCopy
Copia y mueve archivos con rsync, como TeraCopy

description.p: RGCopy takes over Ctrl+V in your file manager: copy or cut files in Nautilus, Nemo or Caja, paste them, and RGCopy copies them with rsync in one window that lists every transfer.

ul.li: Pause, resume, skip a file or cancel, and run an interrupted copy again to finish only what is missing
A bar for the current file and one for the whole list, a live speed chart and the time left
Asks once, before copying, what to do with files that already exist
Checksum verification, and close or shut down when everything is done
Moves within one disk are instant

description.p: RGCopy toma el Ctrl+V de tu gestor de archivos: copia o corta en Nautilus, Nemo o Caja, pega, y RGCopy hace la copia con rsync en una ventana que lista todas las transferencias.

screenshot.caption: A copy in progress with the list of transfers
Files that already exist at the destination

description.p: A full rebuild on rsync: Ctrl+V in the file manager, a TeraCopy-style window with a list of transfers, conflict questions, skipping, verification and packages for every distribution.
